title: End-to-End Sequence OCR & Handwritten Text Recognition Pipeline
description: Implemented an alignment-free sequence recognition pipeline to transcribe variable-length, highly noisy numeric sequences and CAPTCHA-like images.
shortDescription: CRNN + CTC pipeline for noisy variable-length sequence recognition
highlights: Constructed a CRNN combining convolutional backbones for visual feature extraction with Bidirectional LSTMs to capture temporal sequential dependencies.
Used Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) Loss to train without expensive character-level segmentation on variable-length inputs (2 to 6+ digits).
